messages:
Samir: Quick thread to capture owners and exact abort criteria from the KV-cache OOM postmortem. Need backups and deadlines.
Anya: I will own profiling and RCA validation. Plan: take two snapshots per shard during low/high churn and upload diffs. ETA: Fri EOD.
Javier: I'll own soft_limit changes and the staged rollout. Plan: 3% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation windows. Abort if p95 latency +20ms OR evictions/sec > 2x baseline. Backup: Priya.
Priya: I'll add telemetry and alerts: fragmentation_ratio per-shard and kv_residency_bytes per-model. Alert when fragmentation delta > 12% for 10m. I'll add dashboard tiles and a Grafana playbook link. ETA: Thu EOD.
Maya: I'll build an emergency reclaim (slab_compact) job with a UI toggle requiring 2 approvers; safety: abort if CPU > 70%. ETA: 48h.
Samir: Owners + backups recap: profiling (Anya, backup Maya) by 2026-03-27 EOD; canary config + rollback automation (Javier, backup Priya) by 2026-03-25 AM; alerts/dashboard (Priya, backup Samir) by 2026-03-26 EOD; reclaim job (Maya) 48h.
Anya: Profiling commands (short):
```
kv_snapshot --shard=$SHARD --out=/tmp/kv-$SHARD.$TS.snap
kv_diff /tmp/kv-*.snap > /tmp/diff.$TS.txt
```
Artifacts will go to s3://redwood-oom/postmortem-2234567890/.
Javier: Config snippet for canary: `soft_limit_ratio: 0.72, eviction_policy: lru_aggressive, prefix_warmer.max_active: 0` per-model override for churny models.
Priya: Runbook short: trigger -> fragmentation_delta >12% OR evictions/sec >150 for 10m. Actions -> disable warmers top-3 models, throttle heavy writers (10% steps), run reclaim job if needed (2 approvers), escalate to infra after 30m.
Samir: Meeting cadence: weekly triage for 6 weeks; first follow-up Mon next week. eng-oncall-bot, schedule a reminder.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder created: "KV fragmentation triage" 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC attendees: eng-runtime.
Maya: Also adding a staging integration that ramps sequence length to detect GC pressure. Will put test in ci/integration/kv_gc_sequence_test.
Samir: Thanks. If abort criteria hit during canary, run rollback automation and page oncall immediately. Create blockers in the postmortem doc if tasks slip. :thumbsup:
